title: Ching Yang

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
E. O. REC
293
April 27, 1916. 2/4/16

Military Situation.

There are a crop of rumours concerning the fighting which took place in the vicinity of Wusieh during the past few days. The following account is the result of careful investigation and it may be taken as substantially correct.
About 8 days ago the rebels in Kiangyin sent representatives to Wusieh who requested a loan of $60,000.00 from the Chamber of Commerce in that City They threatened that they would attack the City if the money was not forthcoming. The Chamber of Commerce while pretending to the rebel representatives that they were considering the matter, sent a telegram to Chiangchun Feng of Nanking requesting him to send troops to guard the City. As a result of this request about 500 infantry and 500 cavalrymen arrived in Wusieh from Nanking about noon on 22nd instant. The same day the Chamber of Commerce announced to the rebel representatives that they declined to accede to their request.
About 9.30 a.m. 23rd instant the Nanking soldiers started from Wusieh with the intention of taking up a position at some point between that City and Kiangyin where they would intercept soldiers who were sent from Kiangyin to attack Wusieh. The infantry travelled by boat and the cavalry by land, both forces keeping in touch with each other. The Kiangyin rebels learned of the plans of the Government troops and came forward to meet them with the result that when the Northern troops reached a point some twenty li ~~to the north~~ ~~west of~~ Wusieh ~~City~~ about 5.30 p.m. 23rd instant the rebels who were under cover opened fire on them with rifles and field guns killing and wounding several Government soldiers and sinking one of their boats. The latter then beat a retreat to Wusieh. The rebels did not pursue them.
The following day the Government troops who had come from Nanking were re-inforced by troops from Woosieh City. They returned to the attack and drove the rebels back to a place called Ching Yang 清場 some twenty li from Woosieh. The rebel outposts are still at that place. Since the incidents mentioned took place, further contingents of Government troops have arrived in Woosieh from Woosung and Nanking. It is estimated that there are now three thousand Government soldiers in Wusieh and another thousand are expected to arrive very soon. It is stated that these troops will march against the Kiangyin forces and that another contingent of Government troops will advance on that place from Changchow. The rebels have little chance of successfully resisting these converging forces and it is feared that they will split up and form themselves into numerous robber bands.
No firing has been heard in Wusieh since 2 a.m. 24th inst. The shops which had been closed since the evening of 23rd inst began to open on the afternoon of that day and everything had assumed a normal appearance on 25th inst.
The Nanking soldiers have established their headquarters in the Chi Ta hotel. No looting has taken place in Wusieh and on the whole the Government troops seem to be well disciplined and behaved but the people here are greatly perturbed in consequence of a rumour that some of General Chang Hsun's troops are being sent here.
Five men alleged to be rebel spies were arrested in Woosieh on 24th inst and shot the following day.

刑事侦缉处
东方记录
293
1916年4月27日。16/4/2

军事局势。

关于过去几天在吴淞附近发生的战斗，谣言四起。以下叙述系经仔细调查所得，可视为基本属实。
约八天前，江阴的反叛者派遣代表前往吴淞，向该地商会请求借款六万美元。他们威胁称，若款项不到位，将进攻该城。商会一方面佯装正在考虑此事以敷衍反叛者代表，另一方面致电南京的冯国璋（Chiangchun Feng，音译），请其派兵护城。应此请求，约五百名步兵和五百名骑兵于本月22日中午前后从南京抵达吴淞。同日，商会告知反叛者代表，拒绝其请求。
本月23日上午9时30分左右，南京军队从吴淞出发，拟在该城与江阴之间的某处占据阵地，以拦截从江阴派来进攻吴淞的士兵。步兵乘船，骑兵走陆路，两支部队保持联络。江阴反叛者获悉政府军计划后，前来迎击。结果，当北军于本月23日下午5时30分左右抵达吴淞以北约二十里处时，隐蔽中的反叛者用步枪和野战炮向他们开火，造成数名政府军士兵伤亡，并击沉其中一艘船只。随后政府军撤退回吴淞。反叛者未予追击。
次日，来自南京的政府军得到吴淞本地部队的增援。他们重新发起进攻，将反叛者驱退至距吴淞约二十里的一个名为清場的地方。反叛者的前哨阵地仍驻守该处。自上述事件发生以来，又有后续批次的政府军从吴淞口和南京抵达吴淞。据估计，目前吴淞已有三千名政府军士兵，另有一千人预计很快到达。据悉，这些部队将向江阴势力进发，另一支政府军部队也将从常州向该地推进。反叛者成功抵抗这些合围部队的希望渺茫，令人担忧的是，他们可能会溃散并组成众多匪帮。
自本月24日凌晨2时起，吴淞未再听到枪声。自23日晚关闭的店铺于当日下午开始重新营业，至25日一切已恢复正常面貌。
南京军队将其总部设在吉达旅馆（Chi Ta hotel，音译）。吴淞未发生抢劫事件，总体而言，政府军似乎纪律严明、行为端正，但当地民众因传闻张勋将军的部分部队正被派往此地而深感不安。
本月24日，五名涉嫌为反叛者间谍的人在吴淞被捕，并于次日被枪决。
